Review Agent changes
Use Left and Right arrows to move between toolbar actions. Previous and Next reveal each change. Accept or reject the current change or the file. File operations are reviewed as one atomic change set. Press Escape to return to the editor. Use the Review Agent changes command to review closed or deleted files.
